node.statement: Assume j~k and k~l. Choose nonzero X in S_{P_j,P_k} and nonzero Y in S_{P_k,P_l}. By def-compressed-corner their compressed product Z:=X dot Y belongs to S_{P_j,P_l}. Applying lem-extcb-one-dimensional-product to (P_j,P_k,P_l), since P_k is one-dimensional and e=2t<=e_PQR, gives ||Z|| >= (1-C_PQR*e)||X||||Y|| >= (1/2)||X||||Y||>0; thus S_{P_j,P_l} is nonzero.
